description: What one governed outbound file contains: the record type, the fields and their column names, the filter, the format and who may run it. Every run is an Export Batch. A scheduled run writes only to a folder under the drop root the server administrator has configured; without one nothing is written anywhere.

fields.description: What the file is for and who receives it, in a sentence.
fields.label: Description
Records
fields.options:
Governance Forum
Governing Document
Escalation Matter

fields.description: The system the file is prepared for. Recorded on every batch; nothing is sent to it by the platform.
fields.label: Target System

fields.description: One field per line, as fieldname or fieldname = Column heading. Empty uses the standard fields for the record type. The record's identifier is always the first column, so the receiving system can link back.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: Which records, as field and value pairs, for example {"is_active": 1}. Empty exports every record the person running it may read.
fields.label: Filter

fields.description: Off: sensitive escalations, confidential forums and confidential or restricted documents are left out even for someone who may read them. On: they are included only for someone who may read them, and never in a scheduled drop.
fields.label: Include restricted records

fields.description: At most this many rows per file, and never more than 5,000. A file that reaches the limit says so on its batch.
fields.label: Row Limit

fields.description: One role per line. Administrators may always run it. A person also needs read access to the records.
fields.label: Roles That May Run It

fields.description: A folder name under the server's export drop root (consilium_export_drop_root in the site configuration). Not a full path: the root is the server administrator's decision.
fields.label: Drop Folder

fields.description: The person whose read access a scheduled run uses. Required for a scheduled drop.
fields.label: Scheduled Runs Read As

name: Export Profile
